claims.predicate: has a material defence posture enrichment

claims.predicate: has a material defence posture enrichment

claims.analystNote: Supports only the bounded defence_posture update. The company release and public ship factsheet do not establish final quantities, complete contract terms, delivery acceptance, ship integration results, current production throughput, or lifecycle availability outcomes.

claims.predicate: has a material defence posture enrichment

claims.predicate: has a material defence posture enrichment
